reviews.title: Real Deal
reviews.text: I’ve been doing these workouts for years. Like the variations, the options, and the results. Coaches talk through technique, and make it fun.

reviews.title: Look forward every morning to work out
reviews.text: At 67, finally decided it was time to exercise beyond long walks. HASfit programs are fabulous. I look forward to every workout. They keep you moving, never get boring, love the constant encouragement, are just enough to get my heart going and muscles working.  Doing my first program for beginners. Can’t wait to advance. Thank you!

reviews.title: Incredibly grateful! The only app subscription I never let expire!!
reviews.text: Thank you thank you thank you Coach Kozak and Claudia for over 7 years of exceptional coaching, challenging workouts, lifesaving banter and unending encouragement. Year after year I continue to enjoy your content. My focus has changed several times over the years and your app always has what I need, each workout greeting me with a welcomed smile and kick in the butt to train harder than the day before. Your app is the only one I never forget to renew, you two are like family to me now! Sending so much gratitude your way, I wouldn’t know what to do without you guys and I hope I never have to find out!!

reviews.title: 66 and still working on Fitness
reviews.text: I retired last year and now finally have the time and energy to take care of myself.  I have been following beginner programs on HASfit and while I have not lost a single pound, I have seen many benefits in my flexibility, strength and endurance.  I like the changes I have seen and highly recommend

reviews.title: Used to love this team!
reviews.text: I was a faithful HASFIT user until I had to recover from a back surgery. Now that I can exercise again I can’t use HSFIT. I am so disappointed! I cannot get any of the workouts to run on my iPhone like I used to. I am unable to sign in to Utube for access. I am so frustrated!

reviews.title: Awesome!!
reviews.text: If you are over 60 this is the perfect workout for you. They help with strength and balance. Now that I am on a GLP1 prescription my nutrition sit has me working out and HASfit not only is helping me manage my weight it it also helping me manage this prescription in a healthy way!

reviews.title: Worth it
reviews.text:
Reasonable yearly subscription considering all other apps out there plus there’s tons of workouts and variations to choose from. 
It feels like you’re on a zoom call with a personal trainer. It does seem fake or try-hard to make the app aesthetic or workouts to be aesthetic. It’s one goal, one mind, one body all training together with two coaches.

reviews.title: 63 and stronger
reviews.text:
A Special Shout-Out to HASfit! ❤️

I wanted to take a moment to give a huge shout-out to HASfit, Coach Kozak, and Claudia.

When I first started, I was doing the Senior Strength Training workouts from a chair. I stayed with those workouts for about a month, and then I decided to purchase a yearly subscription and take on the 90-Day Programs that worked best for me. I’ve now been at it for six months!

I’m so happy to share that I went to the doctor yesterday, and I’m down 10 pounds! 🎉 My cholesterol has also dropped 23 points, and all of my numbers have gone down. I still have some work to do, but I’m very happy with the progress I’ve made so far.

I’m 63 years old, and I can honestly say that starting HASfit has been one of the best things I’ve ever done for myself.

Thank you, Coach Kozak and Claudia, for creating workouts that truly make people of all ages and fitness levels feel like they can succeed. You have motivated me to keep going, get stronger, and believe that I can do this.

I’ll be checking in again after my next six-month visit. I can’t wait to see how much more progress I’ve made!

Thank you, HASfit, for helping me become stronger and healthier! ❤️💪

reviews.title: Love it!
reviews.text: Not intimidating, easy to begin and easy to maintain, love this app!

reviews.title: With Deep Gratitude
reviews.text:
Coach and Claudia, I cannot thank you enough for the workout programs that you have shared with us. 

Following your existing programs and programs that I’ve designed for my fitness level has been game changing for my health. At 55, I feel that I’m in better shape than I have been in 30 years!

And your banter keeps me smiling through challenging workouts! God bless.

reviews.title: Great workouts with tons of options.
reviews.text: I have the free version of the app, so I can’t speak to all the features, but I love the hundreds of different workouts I am able to choose from. Coach Kozak and Claudia do a great job of modeling each exercise and explaining how they work different muscle groups. I love that there is always a warm-up and cooldown included. The workout descriptions are also helpful if there are exercises I want to avoid because of injury (or I just don’t want to do push-up’s today) I’ve been doing their workouts for years. Even when I try something different, I always seem to come back to HASfit!

reviews.title: Amazing Workouts
reviews.text: I’ve been using the HASfit app (and also YouTube videos) for several weeks now and I can see a huge difference in my body composition. I am a beginner, and what I love most about these workouts are Coach and Claudia’s cueing. They give such great cues, and that really changed the game for me! I can see myself following these workouts for a long time to come!

reviews.title: Best workout programs ever!
reviews.text: The variety and quality of workouts is unsurpassed. The presenters are so personable and knowledgeable. I appreciate that they offer variations to accommodate injuries. Highly recommend.

reviews.title: The best
reviews.text: I love the energy that coach Kozak and Claudia bring to the workouts. I feel capable and empowered, it's made me physically strong but also mentally. I am so grateful my partner found HAS Fit because this is the most consistent and fit I've ever been! Thank you!!

reviews.title: Life style
reviews.text:
I’ve tried a lot of workout programs, but HASfit has been the one I’ve actually stuck with. Coach Kozak and Claudia make an incredible team, and their workouts are realistic, encouraging, and effective for every fitness level.

What I love most is that they focus on progress, not perfection. There are workouts for beginners and advanced users, with modifications that make it easy to meet yourself where you are. They motivate you without making you feel guilty or like you have to be perfect.

Since starting HASfit, I’ve noticed positive changes not only in my body but also in my mindset. I feel stronger, healthier, and more confident. Their positive encouragement keeps me coming back, and the workouts are challenging without feeling impossible.

If you’re looking for a workout program that’s sustainable, uplifting, and truly works, I can’t recommend HASfit enough. It’s more than just exercise...it’s a community that helps you become stronger both physically and mentally.

reviews.title: Great work
reviews.text: I’m 79 and I’ve been working out with HASfit for 11years. This has not only benefited me all around but help with my running. Keep up the great work.

reviews.title: Sciatica Relief
reviews.text: I love this app for my sciatica pain relief. The exercises are easy to follow and the tips are most helpful. I finish the workouts and feel great. Though my sciatic pain is not fully gone, it's manageable. And I know, in time, full relief will come. I love my results so much I've sent the app to several of my family members and friends. ❤️ 🏋🏾‍♀️#Stronger

reviews.title: Part of life
reviews.text: Thankful for Hasfit. It has fit my life so well and challenged me. 🙏🏼💪

reviews.title: Great workout, they pull you farther than you would go on your own!
reviews.text: At 75, I’m stronger and more fit than most people I know. I attribute this to my workout Rashi, which includes four days of cycling, and three days of resistance training with HASFit. I lift heavier, longer, and better with this program than I would on my own! Thank you, Coach, Kozak, and Claudia💝

reviews.title: Consistently challenging
reviews.text: I have been following Coach for years now and there is always something new to learn and challenge to overcome come. I am not as fit as I’d like to be, but Coach has always been there with encouragement and the tools necessary for getting me there.

reviews.title: Great workouts and direction. Motivation is over the top.
reviews.text: The workouts are great and very customizable for your fitness level. The Direction for properForm is really helpful throughout the work out. I have to say though at some point throughout the work out, I’m saying out loud, “Coach K please shut up.” I appreciate he’s trying to motivate us, but it’s just too much sometimes you just need a bit of quiet concentrate. he doesn’t have to talk all the time.

reviews.title: The absolute best fitness teachers and app
reviews.text:
I never write reviews but am doing so here because HASfit is awesome! I started doing workouts on their Youtube channel and found that Coach Kozak and Claudia designed the perfect workouts and motivated me in a way that was magic. They have a great variety of short workouts so that i can do it on busy days (theres too many!) and stay on track. Youtube has become a hellscape of ads and although i didn’t love downloading another app I am so glad I did. No data stealing, no annoying pop ups, only one ad before each workout.. its the best! 

I see a trainer now but may end up getting a membership as well to get a program together. 

I only wish the app tracked my workouts (maybe it does and i cant find it) and I would like to know if the membership adds features to help show your progress. But these are minor requests. GET THIS APP!

reviews.title: Senior HAS Strength
reviews.text: Love Coach and Claudia! I just show up and do their targeted exercises. They are so encouraging. I’m on my way to recovery from pain in shoulder, hips and legs and I am controlling my body again. It feels so right.

reviews.title: First Time Look
reviews.text: My first time maneuvering thru the app has been great!   The choices are endless and done with care and proper form.  Love the option of custom workouts!  Excited about beginning tomorrow!

reviews.title: Sciatica relief
reviews.text: Your rehab workouts for the lower back have been a blessing to me. It brings me relief without taking any medications. You guys are doing an awesome job. Thank you for the work you do.

reviews.title: Best all around at home dumbbell workout!!
reviews.text: I’ve been working out with Coach Kozak and Claudia’s HASfit at home for YEARS and they are the best!!   I’m approaching my 70th birthday and their Weight Training For Strength routines have helped immensely with not only with strength but also my osteoporosis and balance. My twice a week workouts with HASfit are not an option, they’re a must if I want to stay in shape!

reviews.title: MMA/Kickboxing Workouts
reviews.text:
I came across HASfit several years ago and have sporadically used some of their workouts here and there.

I retired at the age of 38 after 20 years in the Marine Corps with seven years being a part of Marine Special Operations. I’ve also done a ton of martial arts in my adulthood and have my master trainer certification and have been doing personal training for years. 

I recently decided that I no longer wanted to spend two hours at the gym training or lifting and got back on this app to try out some of the 30 to 45 minute workout workouts. I immediately gravitated to the MMA/Kickboxing workouts and I absolutely love them. 

If Coach Kozak’s other workouts are even remotely as good as these then they are all top notch! 

You get great day workouts with no other fluff. If you can keep up with the coach, you’re in for a hell of a workout and he’s right there with you the entire time. If you’re on the fence, I’d say go for it and give HASfit a try! You won’t be disappointed.

reviews.title: Rewind feature
reviews.text: I like watching on YouTube because I can rewind 10 seconds easily. In the app it’s not easy to go back a few seconds.

reviews.title: Sticking with it
reviews.text: I’ve been on vitality program for about 250 days and really enjoy it. Always something different and great coaches.

reviews.title: The Best
reviews.text: HASfit workouts always make me feel better, stronger, and so accomplished! The easiest programs to stick with :)

reviews.title: Life changing
reviews.text: I’ve been doing HASfit workouts for several years. They’ve given me stability and endurance for my active lifestyle and longevity in the dance education field. The workouts have really helped me navigate  through my 40’s and the constantly shifting changes of my body.  Love HASfit and recommend it to all my friends!

reviews.title: Saved my husband’s back!
reviews.text: Thank you Coach and Claudia. While I’ve been working out with you for a while, my husband recently hurt his back and was crippled by pain. After a lot of coaxing, he finally agreed to try one of your back pain workouts.  Slowly but surely his back is much better now! Now he’s a HasFit fan like me!  BTW, I’m loving the One and Done Program.

reviews.title: I love these workouts
reviews.text: I got tired of going to the gym and dealing with the crowds. I was also getting bored, needing new ideas. I found HASfit and tried it out. I really enjoy these workouts and the way they are presented. Great job!

reviews.title: Perfect quick home workout
reviews.text: Hot couple, burning workouts! Have seen surprising results in 6 months!

reviews.title: Great videos!
reviews.text: This easy to follow series has helped me to develop a good workout habit. I appreciate the modifications, instructions on when to inhale and exhale, and the brief demonstrations before each move. The warmups and cooldowns are great before and after the workouts but are also helpful for stretch breaks throughout the day.

reviews.title: My home program for years
reviews.text: I’ve been doing HasFit for a long time. Love that it keeps me on track and hitting goal. Love feeling stronger every day.

reviews.title: Always feel better
reviews.text: I’m 75 years old and I LOVE HASFIT.  The exercises are challenging but doable and the running encouragement from Coach and Claudia make me feel energized.  I love the sessions because I know I’m doing something really good for my body. I always feel better after I work out with HASFIT.

reviews.title: Surgery recovery
reviews.text: I recently had shoulder surgery and found there program to be very effective. Several years ago my sciatica was very painful and following their instructions was just what I needed for total relief.

reviews.title: Best workout app out there
reviews.text: This app is full of variety and positivity. The coaches are low key and explain how to do each move while they’re doing it with you.  They are genuine and encouraging and I can tell the workouts make a difference in my body when I’m consistent.

reviews.title: Menopausal workout
reviews.text: Just finished this program. It is amazing how much better I feel and how much stronger I am. I am a 66 y/o grandma and I have so much more entry to hang with the grandkids. Love this app!!

reviews.title: My favorite people to work out with
reviews.text: Working out with these two a few times during the work week is so helpful. The variations in each set are great, and Coach Kozak and Claudia are right there with you feeling all the feels. The crunch program with the quick 30-45 minute sessions are perfect and I always leave feeling stronger. And it motivated me to buy myself some weights and stop paying for a gym membership!

reviews.title: awesome workout
reviews.text: love all your workouts but I loved this one bc it was versatile and no repeats.  you guys are awesome!

reviews.title: Great for seniors
reviews.text: I am a 70 year old African American male, and I just finished losing 80 pounds. It took one year of diet and exercise (treadmill exclusively). I knew I needed strength and total body workouts. This is one of the greatest apps to find senior appropriate exercises. I appreciate the pace, the two instructors that give you the option of standing or sitting. The instructors are always encouraging. My wife is now using the videos as well.

reviews.title: I feel bad
reviews.text: I just love how HASfit LITERALLY comments on every review did anyone notice that 😂😂

reviews.title: Does it all
reviews.text: Thank-you so much! So many options for Fitness levels and I love the warm up & cool down which is included as part of each program. The rehab & mobility are a great help! I look forward to working out & the gifts you both offer in kindness & encouragement! 🙏✌️❤️ Ms Jain

reviews.title: Excellent home workouts
reviews.text: I am a 65 year old woman and I love working out.  These workouts are an excellent option for people who don’t like the gym.  I have tons of workouts but I always come back to hasfit. I do mostly strength training because when you get older you need to do weights for your bones.  I have a monthly subscription and the price cannot be beat.  I have completed several programs.  I don’t plan to stop working out any time soon.  As long as my body permits, I’ll be on the mat.

reviews.title: Don’t Upgrade!
reviews.text:
Very  angry, new upgrade appears to force subscription to access find and selection option. Very disappointed , very disappointed! 

Used to be a great resource and was ok with forced commercials as was a great  offering. I do however  detest forced choices and on some levels feels like bait and switch to me.

reviews.title: Over 60
reviews.text: Still haven’t found a 30 day program for strength training for seniors.  HIIT is not for me or my husband.

reviews.title: Loving this app
reviews.text: Wife and me love all there workouts

reviews.title: HASfit had changed my life!!!
reviews.text: Ive used other workout apps and this is by far the best. It’s super easy to navigate and the programs are perfect from beginner to more advanced allowing you to focus on the type of fitness journey you are on. Coach Kozak and his lovely wife are laid back and professional. I love the workouts and that I’m seeing results so quickly. I highly recommend this app!
